subcommands.name: create-job
subcommands.description: When you create a job, Elastic Transcoder returns JSON data that includes the values that you specified plus information about the job that is created.

options.name: --pipeline-id
options.description: The Id of the pipeline that you want Elastic Transcoder to use for transcoding.

options.name: --input
options.description: A section of the request body that provides information about the file that is being transcoded

options.name: --inputs
options.description: A section of the request body that provides information about the files that are being transcoded

options.name: --outputs
options.description: A section of the request body that provides information about the transcoded (target) files.

options.name: --output-key-prefix
options.description: The value, if any, that you want Elastic Transcoder to prepend to the names of all files that this job creates, including output files, thumbnails, and playlists

options.name: --playlists
options.description: If you specify a preset in PresetId for which the value of Container is fmp4 (Fragmented MP4) or ts (MPEG-TS), Playlists contains information about the master playlists that you want Elastic Transcoder to create.

options.name: --user-metadata
options.description: User-defined metadata that you want to associate with an Elastic Transcoder job.

options.name: --job-output
options.description: A section of the request body that provides information about the transcoded (target) file.
